name: Create Ticket
plugin_description: Integrates with Zendesk to manage support tickets from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Opens a new ticket in the connected Zendesk account with a subject and an initial comment, optionally setting requester, priority, type, status, tags, assignee, group, external ID, and custom fields.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.label: Ticket Title
inputs.hint: The ticket's title, shown in Zendesk's ticket list and notifications.

inputs.name: comment_body
inputs.label: Description
inputs.hint: Becomes the ticket's description and initial public comment.

inputs.name: requester_email
inputs.label: Requester Email
inputs.hint: Attributes the ticket to this requester, creating them if they don't already exist. Leave blank to use the connected Zendesk account as requester.

inputs.name: requester_name
inputs.label: Requester Name
inputs.hint: Only used when Requester Email is also set. Effectively required if that email doesn't already exist in Zendesk — creating a new requester without a name fails.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.label: Priority
inputs.hint: One of: urgent, high, normal, low.

inputs.name: type
inputs.label: Ticket Type
inputs.hint: One of: problem, incident, question, task.

inputs.name: ticket_status
inputs.label: Status
inputs.hint: One of: new, open, pending, hold, solved, closed. Defaults to open. 'pending' requires Assignee ID. 'new' may come back as 'open'; 'hold' may fail if Custom Ticket Statuses is enabled on your account.

inputs.name: ticket_tags
inputs.label: Tags
inputs.hint: Comma-separated list of tags, e.g. vip,billing

inputs.name: assignee_id
inputs.label: Assignee ID
inputs.hint: Numeric Zendesk agent ID — visible in the agent's profile URL in Zendesk Admin Center (Team members).

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.label: Group ID
inputs.hint: Numeric Zendesk group ID — visible in the group's URL under Admin Center → People → Groups.

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.label: External ID
inputs.hint: Your own reference ID (e.g. a Kizen record ID) to correlate this ticket back to.

inputs.name: custom_fields
inputs.label: Custom Fields
inputs.hint: JSON array string of custom field objects, e.g. [{"id": 360000123456, "value": "abc"}]

outputs.name: created_at
outputs.label: Created At
outputs.hint: ISO 8601 timestamp as returned by Zendesk.
